title: Triangulated strict scalar extension
statement: For l, E, L, ι and X satisfying the hypotheses of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], the functor (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X) admits a CommShift over ℤ and is IsTriangulated.

proof.text: The strict Roos scalar functor is constructed on flat-term K-flat representatives. Finite-free tensoring preserves signed cones and shifts, and exact products preserve the Roos total-limit triangles. The localization universal property transports the shift and distinguished triangles to the ambient derived functor.
The construction already supplies a coherent shift for the selected localization lift. Apply the preceding triangulatedness theorem to that shift and package it with the existential conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_invertibility_triangulated :
    ∃ (_ : (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).CommShift ℤ),
      (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).IsTriangulated
